title: Glowing telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Tripod legs -->
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="30" y2="92" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="70" y2="92" stroke="#29B6F6" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="50" y2="95" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tripod center joint -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="4" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <!-- Telescope tube body -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="60" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1E88E5"/>
  <!-- Tube highlight -->
  <rect x="24" y="33" width="52" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#42A5F5"/>
  <!-- Front lens end -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="41" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#0D47A1"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="41" rx="5" ry="9" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Lens glow -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="41" rx="3" ry="6" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <!-- Back eyepiece -->
  <rect x="14" y="34" width="10" height="14" rx="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <ellipse cx="14" cy="41" rx="3" ry="7" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <!-- Decorative bands -->
  <rect x="34" y="30" width="4" height="22" fill="#90CAF9"/>
  <rect x="60" y="30" width="4" height="22" fill="#90CAF9"/>
  <!-- Glow around lens -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="41" rx="11" ry="16" fill="#FFD54F" opacity="0.25"/>
  <!-- Small star sparkles near lens -->
  <circle cx="90" cy="28" r="2" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="44" r="1.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
</svg>
